name: mesh-gradient-background
title: Mesh Gradient Background
description: A bright green animated backdrop with a bold white line of text centred over it; soft light pools swell and shift behind the words as it runs.
use: A marketing hero wants a bright, energetic backdrop with a place for a large headline.
avoid: Light text on lime green has weak contrast, and the saturated field fights most brand palettes.
a11y: Canvas has no role or description and the perpetual motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion; the headline itself is real, readable text. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The frame is a bright lime-green field filled with soft, rounded pools of lighter and darker green, like light through water. Centred in white, heavy sans-serif text reads 'Fresh ideas, daily', casting a faint drop shadow.
behaves: The green pools keep swelling and drifting across the field, brightening to near-white in places, so the backdrop slowly changes without any input. The heading stays fixed and readable throughout.
customise: Only the headline text is a prop (title); the green palette, gradient shape, camera and lighting are fixed inside the file and need editing.
weight: heavy: A Three.js canvas with bloom, ambient occlusion and noise post-processing runs every frame.
issues: White text on lime green has low contrast, softened further by the drop shadow.
The 3D blob is almost invisible against the same-green background, so the effect reads as a plain blur.
polishWhy: Smooth, bright gradient and clean typography; the white-on-lime headline is hard to read.
